actions.selectPullSource.en: Select a remote and source branch
actions.selectPullSource.zh-CN: 请选择远程仓库和来源分支

actions.chooseOrEnterSourceBranch.en: Choose or enter a branch name

actions.pullSourceIsOneTime.en: This source is used for this Pull only. The upstream configuration stays unchanged.
actions.pullSourceIsOneTime.zh-CN: 来源仅用于本次拉取，不会修改上游配置。

actions.noPullUpstream.en: No upstream source is configured. Select the source for this Pull.
actions.noPullUpstream.zh-CN: 尚未配置上游来源，请选择本次拉取的来源。

actions.pullRequiresLocalBranch.en: Switch to a local branch before pulling.
actions.pullRequiresLocalBranch.zh-CN: 请先切换到本地分支再拉取。

actions.discardAllCounts.en: {{total}} paths: restore or remove {{tracked}} tracked paths; delete {{untracked}} untracked files.
actions.discardAllCounts.zh-CN: 共 {{total}} 个路径：恢复或删除 {{tracked}} 个已跟踪路径，删除 {{untracked}} 个未跟踪文件。

actions.discardAllWarning.en: Discard ALL staged and unstaged changes and delete untracked files. Restore tracked content to the current commit; newly added files will be removed. Committed history and ignored files remain.
actions.discardAllWarning.zh-CN: 丢弃全部暂存和未暂存更改，并删除未跟踪文件。已跟踪内容恢复至当前提交，新增文件将被删除。已提交历史及其他忽略文件保留。

actions.discardUnbornWarning.en: This repository has no commit yet. Clear the Index and delete its added files and untracked files. Other ignored files remain.
actions.discardUnbornWarning.zh-CN: 此仓库尚无提交。将清空暂存区，并删除其中的新增文件及未跟踪文件。其他忽略文件保留。

actions.batchFileCount.en: Apply to all {{count}} files in the current repository, independently of file filters and selection.
actions.batchFileCount.zh-CN: 操作当前仓库的全部 {{count}} 个目标文件，不受文件筛选和选择影响。

actions.preparingDiscard.zh-CN: 正在检查将丢弃的文件…

actions.discardCounts.en: {{total}} files: restore {{tracked}} tracked files; delete {{untracked}} untracked files.
actions.discardCounts.zh-CN: 共 {{total}} 个文件：还原 {{tracked}} 个已跟踪文件，删除 {{untracked}} 个未跟踪文件。

actions.currentBranchCurrentVersion.zh-CN: 当前分支 {{name}} · 当前版本

actions.currentBranchCurrentVersionVaria.zh-CN: 当前分支 {{branch}} · 当前版本

actions.branchNamesCannotStartWithAHyphe.en: Branch names cannot start with a hyphen.
actions.branchNamesCannotStartWithAHyphe.zh-CN: 分支名称不能以连字符开头。

actions.branchNamesCannotContainSpacesTr.en: Branch names cannot contain spaces. Try feature/ux-flow.
actions.branchNamesCannotContainSpacesTr.zh-CN: 分支名称不能包含空格，可用 feature/ux-flow。

actions.branchNamesCannotContainControlC.en: Branch names cannot contain control characters.
actions.branchNamesCannotContainControlC.zh-CN: 分支名称不能包含控制字符。

actions.branchNamesCannotContainOrBacksl.en: Branch names cannot contain ~, ^, :, ?, *, [, or backslash.
actions.branchNamesCannotContainOrBacksl.zh-CN: 分支名称不能包含 ~、^、:、?、*、[ 或反斜杠。

actions.branchNamesCannotContainTwoConse.en: Branch names cannot contain two consecutive dots.
actions.branchNamesCannotContainTwoConse.zh-CN: 分支名称不能包含连续两个点。

actions.branchNamesCannotStartOrEndWithA.en: Branch names cannot start or end with a slash, or contain consecutive slashes.
actions.branchNamesCannotStartOrEndWithA.zh-CN: 分支名称不能以斜杠开头或结尾，也不能包含连续斜杠。

actions.branchNameSegmentsCannotStartWit.en: Branch name segments cannot start with a dot.
actions.branchNameSegmentsCannotStartWit.zh-CN: 分支名称的各段不能以点开头。

actions.branchNameSegmentsCannotEndWithL.en: Branch name segments cannot end with .lock.
actions.branchNameSegmentsCannotEndWithL.zh-CN: 分支名称的各段不能以 .lock 结尾。

actions.branchNamesCannotEndWithADot.en: Branch names cannot end with a dot.
actions.branchNamesCannotEndWithADot.zh-CN: 分支名称不能以点结尾。

actions.aBranchNameCannotBeOnly.en: A branch name cannot be only @.

actions.localBranchAlreadyExistsChooseAn.en: Local branch {{name}} already exists. Choose another branch name.
actions.localBranchAlreadyExistsChooseAn.zh-CN: 本地分支 {{name}} 已存在，请使用其他名称。

actions.branchNameConflictsWithExistingL.en: Branch name conflicts with existing local branch {{name}}. Choose another branch name.
actions.branchNameConflictsWithExistingL.zh-CN: 分支名称与已有本地分支 {{name}} 的路径冲突，请使用其他名称。

actions.selectALocalBranchRemoteAndRemot.en: Select a local branch, remote, and remote branch.
actions.selectALocalBranchRemoteAndRemot.zh-CN: 请选择本地分支、远端和远端分支。

actions.refreshAndReopenTheRemoteTargetC.en: Refresh and reopen the remote target confirmation before Force-with-lease.
actions.refreshAndReopenTheRemoteTargetC.zh-CN: 请刷新并重新打开远端目标确认后，再执行 Force-with-lease。

actions.enterARemoteNameWithoutSpacesSuc.en: Enter a remote name without spaces, such as origin.
actions.enterARemoteNameWithoutSpacesSuc.zh-CN: 请输入不含空格的远端名称，例如 origin。

actions.directDetachedHEADCheckoutIsDisa.en: Direct Detached HEAD Checkout is disabled. Create and switch to a branch.
actions.directDetachedHEADCheckoutIsDisa.zh-CN: 已禁止直接进入 Detached HEAD，请创建分支并切换。

actions.refreshAndReopenTheTagDeletionDi.en: Refresh and reopen the Tag deletion dialog.
actions.refreshAndReopenTheTagDeletionDi.zh-CN: 请刷新并重新打开标签删除窗口。

actions.selectAtLeastOneFileToStash.en: Select at least one file to Stash.
actions.selectAtLeastOneFileToStash.zh-CN: 请至少选择一个文件进行 Stash。

actions.selectAStashAndTryAgain.en: Select a Stash and try again.
actions.selectAStashAndTryAgain.zh-CN: 请选择 Stash 后重试。

actions.chooseAnExistingBranchOrEnterANe.en: Choose an existing branch or enter a new branch name. Detached HEAD is disabled.
actions.chooseAnExistingBranchOrEnterANe.zh-CN: 请选择已有分支或输入新分支名称，当前已禁止 Detached HEAD。

actions.chooseAnExistingBranchANewBranch.en: Choose an existing branch, a new branch, or Detached HEAD.
actions.chooseAnExistingBranchANewBranch.zh-CN: 请选择已有分支、新分支或 Detached HEAD 中的一项。

actions.mainlineParentMustBeAPositiveInt.en: Mainline parent must be a positive integer.
actions.mainlineParentMustBeAPositiveInt.zh-CN: 主线父提交序号必须为正整数。

actions.closingThisWindowLeavesTheGitOpe.en: Closing this window leaves the Git operation paused. Edit and save conflicting files, then return to mark and stage the result.
actions.closingThisWindowLeavesTheGitOpe.zh-CN: 关闭此窗口后 Git 操作仍处于暂停状态。请编辑保存冲突文件，再返回这里标记并暂存结果。

actions.createAndSwitchToABranchToWorkOn.en: Create and switch to a branch to work on this historical version.
actions.createAndSwitchToABranchToWorkOn.zh-CN: 创建并切换到新分支，以使用这个历史版本。

actions.theNewBranchStartsFromThisSelect.en: The new branch starts from this selected version.
actions.theNewBranchStartsFromThisSelect.zh-CN: 新分支将从这个选定版本开始。

actions.forceDeletionOfUnmergedBranches.zh-CN: 强制删除尚未合并的分支

actions.checkoutPreservesChangesWhenPoss.en: Checkout preserves changes when possible; Git stops if they would be overwritten.
actions.checkoutPreservesChangesWhenPoss.zh-CN: 切换会尽可能保留更改；可能覆盖更改时 Git 会停止操作。

actions.thisDeletesBranchesFromTheShared.en: This deletes branches from the shared remote repository.
actions.thisDeletesBranchesFromTheShared.zh-CN: 此操作会从共享远端仓库删除分支。

actions.connectThisLocalRepositoryToARem.en: Connect this local repository to a remote repository. Your local commits are already saved and will not be sent until you Push.
actions.connectThisLocalRepositoryToARem.zh-CN: 将此本地仓库连接到远程仓库。本地提交已经保存，只有推送后才会发送。

actions.thisDirectlyEntersDetachedHEADTh.en: This directly enters Detached HEAD. The original branch stays in place; create a branch to keep any new commits.
actions.thisDirectlyEntersDetachedHEADTh.zh-CN: 此操作将直接进入 Detached HEAD。原分支位置不变；若要保留后续提交，请创建分支。

actions.directDetachedHEADCheckoutIsNowD.en: Direct Detached HEAD Checkout is now disabled.
actions.directDetachedHEADCheckoutIsNowD.zh-CN: 当前已禁止直接进入 Detached HEAD。

actions.noCommitIsSelectedAutomatically.en: No Commit is selected automatically. Enter the Commit ID that this Tag should identify.
actions.noCommitIsSelectedAutomatically.zh-CN: 不会自动选择 HEAD 或图中已选提交，请输入此 Tag 应指向的 Commit ID。

actions.enterACommitIDThatExistsInThisRe.en: Enter a Commit ID that exists in this repository.
actions.enterACommitIDThatExistsInThisRe.zh-CN: 请输入此仓库中存在的 Commit ID。

actions.saveEachSelectedFileSCompleteInd.en: Save each selected file’s complete Index and Working Tree state, even when selected from only Staged or Unstaged Changes. Selected untracked files are included. Other files keep their changes.
actions.saveEachSelectedFileSCompleteInd.zh-CN: 保存每个所选文件完整的 Index 和工作区状态，即使只在已暂存或未暂存的更改中选择。所选未跟踪文件一并保存，其他文件的更改保留。

actions.saveAllTrackedFilesIndexAndWorki.en: Save all tracked files’ Index and Working Tree changes for later, then clear their saved changes from the project.
actions.saveAllTrackedFilesIndexAndWorki.zh-CN: 保存全部已跟踪文件的 Index 和工作区修改供之后恢复，并清理这些已保存的修改。

actions.removeThisEntryItsSavedChangesMa.en: Remove this entry. Its saved changes may become unreachable.
actions.removeThisEntryItsSavedChangesMa.zh-CN: 移除此条目；其中保存的修改可能无法恢复。

actions.restoreTheSavedIndexAndWorkingTr.en: Restore the saved Index and Working Tree state, then remove the Stash only on success. Preflight conflicts stop the entire restore and preserve the current state and entry.
actions.restoreTheSavedIndexAndWorkingTr.zh-CN: 恢复保存的 Index 和工作区状态，仅在成功后删除 Stash。预检发现冲突时停止整次恢复，保留当前现场和存档。

actions.restoreTheSavedIndexAndWorkingTr.en: Restore the saved Index and Working Tree state and keep this Stash. Preflight conflicts stop the entire restore without changing the current state.
actions.restoreTheSavedIndexAndWorkingTr.zh-CN: 恢复保存的 Index 和工作区状态，并保留此 Stash。预检发现冲突时停止整次恢复，当前现场不变。

actions.cannotRestoreBecauseTheseFilesAl.en: Cannot restore because these files already exist in the project.
actions.cannotRestoreBecauseTheseFilesAl.zh-CN: 无法恢复，因为项目中已存在以下文件。

actions.restoreStoppedBecausePreflightFo.en: Restore stopped because preflight found conflicts.
actions.restoreStoppedBecausePreflightFo.zh-CN: 预检发现冲突，已停止恢复。

actions.restoreStoppedBecauseTheProjectC.en: Restore stopped because the project changed during preflight.
actions.restoreStoppedBecauseTheProjectC.zh-CN: 预检期间项目发生变化，已停止恢复。

actions.restoreStoppedBecausePreflightCo.en: Restore stopped because preflight could not restore the saved state.
actions.restoreStoppedBecausePreflightCo.zh-CN: 预检无法恢复保存的现场，已停止恢复。

actions.thisRestoreDidNotChangeTheIndexO.en: This restore did not change the Index or Working Tree. The Stash is still saved. Compare or open a file before deciding how to resolve the blocker.
actions.thisRestoreDidNotChangeTheIndexO.zh-CN: 本次恢复未改动 Index 和工作区，Stash 存档仍然保留。请先比较或打开文件，再决定如何处理阻碍。

actions.compareSavedAndExistingFile.zh-CN: 比较收起内容与现有文件

actions.resolveTheBlockerThenCloseAndRet.en: Resolve the blocker, then close and retry the restore to run preflight again.
actions.resolveTheBlockerThenCloseAndRet.zh-CN: 处理阻碍后，关闭弹窗并重新恢复，以再次预检。

actions.chooseAnExistingBranchOrCreateAN.en: Choose an existing branch or create a new one. Detached HEAD is disabled in Settings > Advanced.
actions.chooseAnExistingBranchOrCreateAN.zh-CN: 请选择已有分支或创建新分支；设置 → 高级中默认禁止 Detached HEAD。

actions.removeEvenWithUncommittedChanges.zh-CN: 强制移除，包括未提交修改

actions.bringSelectedHistoryIntoTheCurre.en: Bring selected history into the current branch.
actions.bringSelectedHistoryIntoTheCurre.zh-CN: 将所选历史合并到当前分支。

actions.replayCurrentBranchCommitsOntoTh.en: Replay current-branch commits onto the selected base. Replayed Commit IDs change.
actions.replayCurrentBranchCommitsOntoTh.zh-CN: 将当前分支的提交重新应用到所选基点；这些提交的 ID 会改变。

actions.mainlineParentMergeCommitsOnly.zh-CN: 主线父提交（仅合并提交）

actions.createNewCommitsReversingTheseCh.en: Create new commits reversing these changes.
actions.createNewCommitsReversingTheseCh.zh-CN: 创建新提交以撤销这些更改。

actions.applyTheseCommitsToTheCurrentBra.en: Apply these commits to the current branch in the entered order.
actions.applyTheseCommitsToTheCurrentBra.zh-CN: 按输入顺序将这些提交应用到当前分支。

actions.keepIndexAndWorkingTreeChanges.en: Keep Index and Working Tree changes.
actions.keepIndexAndWorkingTreeChanges.zh-CN: 保留 Index 和工作区修改。

actions.resetIndexKeepWorkingTreeChanges.en: Reset Index; keep Working Tree changes.
actions.resetIndexKeepWorkingTreeChanges.zh-CN: 重置 Index；保留工作区修改。

actions.resetIndexAndTrackedWorkingTreeF.en: Reset Index and tracked Working Tree files. Uncommitted tracked changes will be lost.
actions.resetIndexAndTrackedWorkingTreeF.zh-CN: 重置 Index 和工作区中的已跟踪文件；这些文件的未提交修改将丢失。

actions.noRemoteRepositoryIsConnectedYet.en: No remote repository is connected yet.

actions.yourCommitsAreSavedLocallyAddARe.en: Your commits are saved locally. Add a remote address before sending them with Push.
actions.yourCommitsAreSavedLocallyAddARe.zh-CN: 你的提交已保存在本地。请先添加远程地址，再通过推送发送。

actions.thisMayReplaceRemoteBranchHistor.en: This may replace remote branch history, but only if its version still matches the target confirmed in this dialog.
actions.thisMayReplaceRemoteBranchHistor.zh-CN: 这可能覆盖远端分支历史，但仅在远端版本仍与本窗口确认的目标版本一致时执行。

actions.createOnlyIfThisRemoteBranchIsSt.en: Create only if this remote branch is still absent.
actions.createOnlyIfThisRemoteBranchIsSt.zh-CN: 仅在此远端分支仍不存在时创建。

actions.thisPushWillSetTheSelectedTarget.en: This Push will set the selected target as the upstream branch.
actions.thisPushWillSetTheSelectedTarget.zh-CN: 本次推送会将所选目标设置为 upstream 分支。

actions.discardUnstagedChangesAndSelecte.en: Discard Unstaged Changes and selected untracked files. Staged Changes remain in the Index.
actions.discardUnstagedChangesAndSelecte.zh-CN: 放弃未暂存的更改和所选未跟踪文件。Index 中已暂存的更改会保留。

actions.abortTheActiveEditsMadeWhileReso.en: Abort the active {{kind}}; edits made while resolving conflicts may be discarded. Closing this window does not abort.
actions.abortTheActiveEditsMadeWhileReso.zh-CN: 中止当前 {{kind}}；解决冲突期间的修改可能被丢弃。关闭此窗口不会中止操作。

actions.gitWillAttemptToRestoreTheOperat.en: Git will attempt to restore the operation start state at Commit
actions.gitWillAttemptToRestoreTheOperat.zh-CN: Git 将尝试恢复到操作开始时的状态，即提交

actions.preExistingLocalChangesMayPreven.en: . Pre-existing local changes may prevent a full restoration.
actions.preExistingLocalChangesMayPreven.zh-CN: 。操作前已有的本地修改可能影响完整恢复。

actions.demoSampleDataOnly.zh-CN: 模拟操作：仅修改示例数据。

actions.thisDeletesTheTagFromTheSharedRe.en: This deletes the Tag from the shared remote repository {{remote}}. The operation stops if the remote Tag has changed.
actions.thisDeletesTheTagFromTheSharedRe.zh-CN: 这会从共享远端仓库 {{remote}} 删除标签；远端标签发生变化时操作会停止。

actions.localAndRemoteTagsIdentifyDiffer.en: The local and remote Tags identify different objects. Both named Tags will be deleted.
actions.localAndRemoteTagsIdentifyDiffer.zh-CN: 本地与远端的同名标签指向不同对象；两个标签都会被删除。

actions.checkTheRemoteTagBeforeDeletingI.en: Check the remote Tag before deleting it.
actions.checkTheRemoteTagBeforeDeletingI.zh-CN: 请先核对远端标签，再执行删除。

actions.remoteTagDeletionRequiresMatchin.en: Remote Tag deletion requires this remote to use the same read and push address.
actions.remoteTagDeletionRequiresMatchin.zh-CN: 删除远端标签要求该远端使用相同的读取与推送地址。

actions.cherryPickReapplyWarning.en: These commits are already in the branch history. Reapply only when their changes were reverted or removed. This can produce conflicts or an empty result.
actions.cherryPickReapplyWarning.zh-CN: 这些提交已经在当前分支历史中。仅在其改动曾被撤销或移除、确需恢复时重新应用；此操作仍可能产生冲突或空结果。
actions.cherryPickReapplyWarning.context: Cherry-pick eligibility and explicit historical reapplication

actions.cherryPickReapplyConfirm.en: I confirm that I want to reapply changes from commits already in this branch.
actions.cherryPickReapplyConfirm.zh-CN: 我确认要重新应用当前分支历史中已有提交的改动。
actions.cherryPickReapplyConfirm.context: Cherry-pick eligibility and explicit historical reapplication

actions.selectTagsAndRemote.en: Select at least one Tag and a Remote.
actions.selectTagsAndRemote.zh-CN: 请选择至少一个标签和一个远程仓库。

actions.pushesOnlyTheListedTags.en: Only the listed Tags will be pushed. Existing remote Tags with different identities are not overwritten.
actions.pushesOnlyTheListedTags.zh-CN: 只会推送上面列出的标签；不会覆盖远端已有但身份不同的同名标签。

actions.pushRelatedAnnotatedTags.zh-CN: 同时推送相关的注解标签

actions.rememberPushTagChoiceAsDefault.en: Remember this Tag choice as the Push default
actions.rememberPushTagChoiceAsDefault.zh-CN: 将此标签选项记为 Push 默认值

actions.followTagsDoesNotPushLightweight.en: This follows Git --follow-tags: lightweight and unrelated Tags are not included.
actions.followTagsDoesNotPushLightweight.zh-CN: 此选项对应 Git --follow-tags，不包含轻量标签或与本分支无关的标签。

actions.rememberTagCreatePushChoiceAsDef.en: Remember this create-and-push choice as default
actions.rememberTagCreatePushChoiceAsDef.zh-CN: 将本次创建后推送选择记为默认

actions.theTagRemainsLocalIfTheRemotePus.en: If the remote push fails, the Tag remains available locally so you can retry it with Push Tag.
actions.theTagRemainsLocalIfTheRemotePus.zh-CN: 如果远端推送失败，标签仍会保留在本地，可稍后通过推送标签重试。

actions.selectARemoteForTheNewTag.en: Select a remote for the new Tag.
actions.selectARemoteForTheNewTag.zh-CN: 请选择新标签要推送到的远端。

actions.rememberResetModeAsDefault.en: Remember this Reset mode as default
actions.rememberResetModeAsDefault.zh-CN: 将此重置模式记为默认
